Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a genealogical error in Step 2 by incorrectly concluding that Richard Beauchamp's paternal grandfather was Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick. The Planner confused Richard's paternal line with his maternal line or misinterpreted the relationship between his father (William de Beauchamp, 1st Baron Bergavenny) and his uncle (Thomas Beauchamp, 12th Earl of Warwick). William de Beauchamp was the son of Thomas Beauchamp (11th Earl of Warwick). Thomas Beauchamp (11th Earl) was the son of Guy de Beauchamp (10th Earl of Warwick). Therefore, Richard Beauchamp's paternal grandfather is Thomas Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick, not Guy. The Planner incorrectly skipped the intermediate generation (Thomas, 11th Earl) or confused the numbering, stating that William's father was Thomas (which is correct) but then erroneously identifying Guy as the grandfather instead of Thomas.
